segments.ja471:1.1: Yesaṃ na kadāci bhūtapubbaṃ, sakhyaṃ [sakkhiṃ (sī. pī.), sakhi (syā.)] sattapadampimasmi loke;
segments.ja471:1.3: Jātā amittā duve sahāyā, paṭisandhāya caranti kissa hetu.
segments.ja471:2.1: Yadi me ajja pātarāsakāle, pañhaṃ na sakkuṇeyyātha vattumetaṃ;
segments.ja471:2.3: Raṭṭhā pabbājayissāmi vo sabbe, na hi mattho duppaññajātikehi.
segments.ja471:3.3: Vikkhittamanā anekacittā, pañhaṃ na sakkuṇoma vattumetaṃ.
segments.ja471:4.1: Ekaggacittāva ekamekā, rahasi gatā atthaṃ nicintayitvā [atthāni cintayitvā (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja471:4.3: Paviveke sammasitvāna dhīrā, atha vakkhanti janinda etamatthaṃ.
segments.ja471:5.3: Na sunakhassa te adenti maṃsaṃ, atha meṇḍassa suṇena sakhyamassa.
segments.ja471:6.3: Na ca te sunakhassa attharanti, atha meṇḍassa suṇena sakhyamassa.
segments.ja471:7.1: Āvellitasiṅgiko hi meṇḍo, na ca sunakhassa visāṇakāni atthi;
segments.ja471:7.3: Tiṇabhakkho maṃsabhojano ca, atha meṇḍassa suṇena sakhyamassa.
segments.ja471:8.1: Tiṇamāsi palāsamāsi meṇḍo, na ca sunakho tiṇamāsi no palāsaṃ;
segments.ja471:8.3: Gaṇheyya suṇo sasaṃ biḷāraṃ, atha meṇḍassa suṇena sakhyamassa.
segments.ja471:9.3: Chādiyamāharatī ayaṃ imassa, maṃsaṃ āharatī ayaṃ amussa.
segments.ja471:10.3: Addakkhi [addasa (syā. ka.)] kira sakkhikaṃ janindo, bubhukkassa puṇṇaṃ mukhassa [bhobhukkhassa ca puṇṇamukhassa (sī.)] cetaṃ.
segments.ja471:11.1: Lābhā vata me anapparūpā, yassa medisā paṇḍitā kulamhi;
segments.ja471:11.3: Pañhassa gambhīragataṃ nipuṇamatthaṃ, paṭivijjhanti subhāsitena dhīrā.
segments.ja471:12.3: Sabbesaṃ vo dammi paṇḍitānaṃ, paramappatītamano subhāsitenāti.
